title: Choujin X
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a city where Choujin, humans transformed into superpowered mutants, dominate after society's collapse, high schooler Tokio is overshadowed by his capable best friend Azuma. When a Choujin attacks them, both take a transforming drug to survive and must learn to live with strange new bodies and powers.
life_message: It holds up accepting oneself, loyal friendship and using power with a sense of justice rather than for domination.

Low self-worth and identity are central; MangaUpdates lists torture (to verify).
Drug injection framed as fantasy device; fights between superhumans.
